LESSON: RELATIONSHIP

Grade: Grade 1
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Strand 6
Topic 6.2: Relationship

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Relationship. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: Why do you take care of c) Appreciate the bounties  Learners draw and colour, trees, Allah’s creation?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. Explain the main ideas in Relationship
2. Practise Relationship at school and at home
3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Relationship

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. Explain the main ideas in Relationship
   In simple words: practise until you can explain the main ideas in Relationship. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. Practise Relationship at school and at home
   In simple words: practise until you can practise Relationship at school and at home. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Relationship
   In simple words: practise until you can give Kenyan examples connected to Relationship. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Relationship using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about Relationship in the examples.
2. Explain Relationship to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Relationship.
4. Practise one skill from this lesson with a friend.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Relationship using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Relationship important for a Grade 1 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 7: CLASS ACTIVITY IDEAS

1. Learners listen/sing qasida and appropriately? earn His blessings. recite poems on Allah’s favours. 4. Why do you take care of c) Appreciate the bounties

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Explain the main ideas in Relationship
2. Practise Relationship at school and at home
3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Relationship

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
